script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now with a challenging square to your ruling planet in the 7th House. Your mind will race between connections and conflicts, especially in partnerships. Today you’ll need caution when welcoming new opportunities, but you’ll gain clarity if you trust your gut. Focus on financial matters in your 10th House—avoid impulsive deals; keep your investments steady. The cosmic message? Your communication sparkles or dims; speak with precision. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how this unfolds.
